tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question: I found the cheapest nonstop SFO→JFK on 2026-11-12 (flight F100, $289). However, I have no record of a "usual hotel" for you in New York — there are no past reservations under your name. Available NYC hotels for 2026-11-12, 2 nights are: Midtown Lodge ($189/night, $378 total), Harbor Inn ($239/night, $478 total), and Plaza Grand ($459/night, $918 total). Which one should I book? (Any of these combined with flight F100 keeps the trip under $1000, so no manager approval would be required.)
